component.name: Pulse
component.summary: Configurable resource meters for the COSMIC panel and dock

description.p: Monitor each logical CPU, RAM, swap, network traffic, disk space and I/O, and supported GPU utilization and memory with compact colored meters.
Configure visibility, refresh cadence, thresholds, bandwidth scales, network interface through cosmic-config; select visible meters and disk mounts in the popup.
Hide unavailable panel readings and add saved visibility and multiple disk mount controls.
Fix missing afterglow on CPU core bars.
Add automated tests, Fedora RPM builds and per-commit snapshot publishing.
Improve sampler error recovery and regression coverage for metrics, graphs and application state.
Add compact CPU bars, CPU history with busiest-core tracking, and sample-driven peak afterglow.
Add manual Fedora RPM distribution and versioned changes.
